# Unified toolbar minimum height combines independent content bounds

The toolbar content minimum is the maximum of a hard minimum, a line-height-based searchbar bound and a button-content bound. Compact changes the hard minimum and shared button padding. Above-text and icons-only descendant classes replace the complete button-content expression, and the custom element supplies those classes from the stored button style. Separate toolbar and focus-ring padding remain outside that content formula. This is a static sizing contract, without rendered equality or a proven cause for the hard minimum.

Scope: Unified toolbar density and button-mode sizing.
